claims: Structurally recursive pass normalizes every pure-wire leaf of any typed mixed circuit using the existing eighteen-law presentation.
Output is idempotent and preserves the exact requirement set, symbolic charge multiset and box multiset, including zero-charge boxes.
A concrete rewrite track from the input to the output is generated. Its full requirement support equals the original circuit requirement set.
Every cartesian pure-wire step, including its four circuit placements, is erased at the level of normalized endpoint syntax.
For any checked shared-state model, the pass preserves input-indexed kernels and repaired joint laws retaining correlated past, original state and input.
The full union admits no existing Strategy whose natural rank decreases for every forward rewrite, by the existing copy-expansion chain.

research_decision.central_claim: Construct an explicit finite family of local comparison schemas for the stated mixed crypto language, with an actual comparison generator and implementation/security contracts; local guard repair alone is not the novelty candidate.
next_proof_obligations: Normalize and fuse adjacent pure-wire circuit fragments, retaining the existing eighteen-law derivations.
For each actual root rewrite, construct its normalized residual using a fixed rule catalogue and a genuine higher square against the normalization witnesses.
Prove coverage and resolution of the remaining mixed and wire-internal critical branchings, without arbitrary parallel-comparison roots.
Connect generated comparisons to code-changing computational reductions, losses and continuing physical execution including oracle internals and key generation.
Compare full encoding, search, construction and checking cost against an ordinary shared proof given identical local lemmas and dependency data.
rejected_shortcuts: Instantiating all-step rank-decreasing Strategy for the full union.
Treating normalized endpoint equality as an existing finite higher homotopy.
Applying cartesian coherence to arbitrary probabilistic/shared-state boxes without copyability contracts.
Counting a normalizer or an arbitrary whole-path comparison as one bounded local generator.
Claiming novelty or intrinsic high-dimensional compression from requirement-set intersection alone.

limits: This pass preserves the box/sequence/tensor skeleton. It does not fuse adjacent circuit wire nodes or normalize circuit association.
No complete finite higher basis, normalized residual compiler or complete mixed critical-pair generator is constructed here.
The witness is a formal proof track allowing inverse equalities, not reverse stochastic execution or native machine execution.
Charge preservation is symbolic, not a runtime, encoded proof-size, peak storage or proof-checker cost bound.
Joint repair compares endpoints within the updated checked model, not distributions across arbitrary model changes.
Previously unfinished NativeConfiguredMAC files remain outside the registered build. Their physical optimized-caller/oracle integration is not claimed verified.
General arbitrary probabilistic-box compilation, code-changing contextual reductions, full cryptosystem execution and fair shared-proof comparisons remain open.

novelty.interpretation: Necessary constructive preprocessing plus an interface obstruction. Not claimed as a new general coherence or proof repair principle.
